purpose: Final closure checkpoint for the Hero-Exclusive Equipment Relation Layer after scope/source freezing, representative fixture validation, full 167-edge generation, full-population/cardinality validation, bidirectional index generation, and Hero/Equipment consumer admission all completed successfully.

sourceSemantics.productionSourceChain: exclusive equipmentId -> ConfigDataEquipmentInfo.ID -> ConfigDataEquipmentInfo.SkillHero -> canonical Hero.heroId
rejectedOwnershipInference: MissionType 77 as a global ownership source

cardinalityInvariant.meaning: The current canonical relation is one-to-one between the 167 released exclusive Equipment records and a 167-Hero owner subset. It does not claim that all 267 canonical Heroes have released exclusive Equipment.
cardinalityInvariant.changePolicy: If explicit future source data introduces shared ownership or more than one current exclusive Equipment for a Hero, mark the old invariant for REVIEW and version the B-stage contract. Never discard or heuristically select edges merely to preserve the old cardinality.

downstreamRules: Hero Stage 5-2 and later Hero exclusive-equipment display must consume byHeroId for ownership membership, then join Equipment Stage 3-5 payload by equipmentId for presentation metadata.
Exclusive Equipment list/detail owner-Hero display must consume byEquipmentId, then join Hero Master by exact heroId for presentation metadata and navigation.
Hero and Equipment page pipelines must not directly read ConfigDataEquipmentInfo.SkillHero to re-derive production ownership after B-6 admission.
General Equipment remains outside Stage B. ArmyIds/JobIds equipability restrictions must never be converted into Hero ownership relations.
Names, descriptions, icons, numeric patterns, sort order and release order are not ownership resolvers.
If a derived index disagrees with canonical relations, regenerate/revalidate the indexes; do not patch ownership from a page pipeline.
If the canonical relation blob changes under the same source semantics, rerun full-population relation validation, index generation and consumer admission before publication.
If ownership source semantics change or an explicit contradiction to EQUIPMENT_SKILL_HERO appears, reopen B-1/B-2 and version the relevant B-stage contracts before regenerating production relations.

closureDecision.reason: The frozen 167 exclusive-equipment population resolves to 167 canonical ownership edges through ConfigDataEquipmentInfo.SkillHero, representative fixtures and the Leon MissionType 77 cross-check agree, full-population validation has zero scope/identity/provenance/cardinality errors, both directional indexes round-trip exactly to the canonical pair set, and Hero/Equipment consumers are admitted to those indexes with zero legacy parity or metadata-coverage mismatch.

resumePoint: Stage B is closed. Future Hero/Equipment page work should consume the accepted B-5 indexes and existing metadata sources. Reopen Stage B only when a new game-data snapshot changes the accepted relation population/content or when explicit source evidence changes the ownership semantics/cardinality contract.
